instruction.name: rdtime.d
instruction.description: Read the stable counter into rd and the timer ID into rj.

throughput.name: rj == 0, 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: rdtime.d $r12, $r0; rdtime.d $r13, $r0; rdtime.d $r14, $r0; rdtime.d $r15, $r0; rdtime.d $r16, $r0; rdtime.d $r17, $r0; rdtime.d $r18, $r0; rdtime.d $r19, $r0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --asm 'rdtime.d $r12, $r0; rdtime.d $r13, $r0; rdtime.d $r14, $r0; rdtime.d $r15, $r0; rdtime.d $r16, $r0; rdtime.d $r17, $r0; rdtime.d $r18, $r0; rdtime.d $r19, $r0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent RDTIME instructions with rj == $r0 take 8.00 cycles. The Counter ID write is discarded, so each instruction retires once.

throughput.name: rj != 0, 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: rdtime.d $r4, $r12; rdtime.d $r5, $r13; rdtime.d $r6, $r14; rdtime.d $r7, $r15; rdtime.d $r8, $r16; rdtime.d $r9, $r17; rdtime.d $r10, $r18; rdtime.d $r11, $r19
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --asm 'rdtime.d $r4, $r12; rdtime.d $r5, $r13; rdtime.d $r6, $r14; rdtime.d $r7, $r15; rdtime.d $r8, $r16; rdtime.d $r9, $r17; rdtime.d $r10, $r18; rdtime.d $r11, $r19'
throughput.notes: 8 independent RDTIME instructions with a non-zero rj destination take 16.00 cycles. Each instruction retires as 2 instructions.

notes: No input operands; latency is not defined. Throughput measured with rj == $r0 and rj != 0.
